'''Edda Adler de Graschinsky'''<ref name="uno">{{cite web|title=Premio Anual "Bernardo A. Houssay|url=http://www.cedi.org.ar/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=293:ejemplo-de-articulo-3&catid=84:investigaciones&Itemid=139|website=cedi.org.ar|publisher=Cediquifa|access-date=24 June 2011|language=es|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150410115339/http://www.cedi.org.ar/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=293:ejemplo-de-articulo-3&catid=84:investigaciones&Itemid=139|archive-date=10 April 2015|url-status=dead}}</ref> (b. 9 August 1937) is an Argentine [[chemist]] and [[biologist]]. She is a senior research of the [[National Scientific and Technical Research Council]] (CONICET) and the {{ill|Institute of Pharmacological Research|es|Instituto de Investigaciones Farmacológicas}}.{{sfn|Clarín|2002|p=20}}<ref name=tres>{{cite web|title=Edda Adler|url=http://www.fundacionkonex.org/b2524-edda_adler|website=fundacionkonex.org|publisher=[[Konex Foundation]]|access-date=18 June 2011|language=es}}</ref>

==Biography==
Edda Adler was born in the [[Argentina|Argentinian]] town of [[Los Toldos]], in the [[Buenos Aires|capital's]] [[Buenos Aires Province|province]], on 9 August 1937.{{sfn|Clarín|2002|p=20}} She began her university studies in 1995 at the [[Faculty of Exact and Natural Sciences]] of the [[University of Buenos Aires]], receiving a degree in [[chemistry]] in 1960. The next year, she began her [[doctoral studies]] in chemistry, graduating in 1964 with her thesis ''Poder antibiótico de cepas de Streptomyces aisladas de muestras de tierra de la República Argentina''.<ref name=cuatro>{{cite web|title=Edda Adler|url=http://www.sicytar.secyt.gov.ar/busqueda/prc_imp_cv_int?f_cod=0000536741|website=sicytar.secyt.gov.ar|publisher=Sistema de Información de Ciencia y Tecnología Argentino|access-date=24 June 2011|language=es|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080511184126/http://www.sicytar.secyt.gov.ar/busqueda/prc_imp_cv_int?f_cod=0000536741|archive-date=11 May 2008}}</ref> In this field, Adler has been involved in the study of the factors and mechanisms that regulate the release of [[neurotransmitters]] and the role played by [[endocannabinoids]] in cardiovascular physiopathology.{{sfn|Clarín|2002|p=20}}<ref name=tres/><ref>{{cite news|title=La plantita interior y el principio del placer|url=http://www.pagina12.com.ar/diario/ciencia/19-91603-2007-09-19.html|access-date=18 June 2011|work=[[Página/12]]|date=19 September 2007|language=es}}</ref> In 1974, she became a researcher at [[National Scientific and Technical Research Council|CONCICET]], once serving as its Director from 1997 to 1998.<ref name=cuatro/> She became the executive director of the {{ill|Institute of Pharmacological Research|es|Instituto de Investigaciones Farmacológicas}} 1991, and led it until 2003.<ref name="uno"/>{{sfn|Clarín|2002|p=20}}
